explanation: The patch propagates FaultingCodeRange values and registers debug-mode OOB trap stack maps, but omits registration for the x64 linear-memory store path. The witness enables wasm baseline debugging and compiles an OOB i32.store, causing CheckStackMapsForTraps to hit the missing map.

verification.edited_result: AddressSanitizer fatal signal at wasm::CheckStackMapsForTraps: trapping instruction lacks a stackmap
